description: NaTb(SiO₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.62 Å. There are two inequivalent Tb sites. In the first Tb site, Tb is bonded to six O atoms to form TbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent TbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Tb-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.32 Å. In the second Tb site, Tb is bonded to six O atoms to form TbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two TbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Tb-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.34 Å. There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TbO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-48°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four TbO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-61°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.64 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three TbO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-62°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.65 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Tb, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Tb, and one Si atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂TbSi trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Tb and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Tb and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Tb, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Tb and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Si atoms.
